name: Mary Fox
source:
The Edenic's housekeeper and highly experienced servant.

Mary appears to be quite mischievous, but in fact she is considerate and thoughtful.

In the past she served as nurse, caring for the Edenic brothers and Alex.

[From [url=http://studiopie.cafe24.com/eng/]official site[/url]]
